grammar-de-coll-abschied-past-full.explanation: The model lemmatized the selected contextual verb and changed its tense instead of preserving the marked past form in normalizedSurface and Surface features.

grammar-de-coll-ende-imperative-full.explanation: The prompt did not make ordinary sentence-initial normalization and mandatory second-person singular imperative features operational enough.

grammar-de-coll-anspruch-participle-full.explanation: The model rejected a complete marked participial Collocation even though the unmarked auxiliary is contextual and every canonical member is selected.

grammar-de-coll-einfluss-present-full.explanation: The model inserted unmarked complement words into normalizedSurface and canonicalForm instead of projecting only selected lexical members.

grammar-de-coll-unresolved-idiom-loeffel.explanation: The route-boundary rule did not override the fixed Collocation route when context positively established the figurative Idiom den Löffel abgeben.

grammar-de-coll-unresolved-construction-.explanation: The prompt did not make the productive paired-frame Construction boundary operational enough, so the model flattened je...desto into a Collocation.

grammar-de-coll-unresolved-marked-depend.explanation: The prompt did not enforce that a marked contextual adjective is a dependent rather than a canonical Collocation member.

grammar-de-coll-unresolved-elliptic-kenn.explanation: The model borrowed an unmarked support verb and morphology from a separate prior occurrence despite the explicit absent-head and no-borrowing policy.

grammar-de-coll-unresolved-present-membe.explanation: The model inserted the present but unmarked determiner and resolved underselection instead of returning Unresolved.
